Best regards,
KCF Sports

test_cases.name: Direct Order Request with Detailed Context
test_cases.description: A verbose customer sends a direct order request, including delivery timing and PO number, and provides extra context about their needs.

initial_turn.subject: Order Request for Multiple Items – PO# 4589, Delivery Needed by July 15
initial_turn.body:
Hello,

I am writing to place a direct order for several items needed for our upcoming summer event. Please reference PO# 4589 for this purchase. We would appreciate delivery by July 15, as our team will be preparing the venue starting July 17.

Here are the items we require:
- 3 units of Kiddie Quest Bicycle
- 5 Playlandia Colorful Play Mats (these will be used in our children's activity area)
- 2 WonderWagon Pull-Along Trains
- 10 T-Shirts (we need a mix of sizes for volunteers, but please let me know what sizes are available so we can specify)
- 1 Rug (for the main entrance, please advise on available color options)

If there are any questions regarding the items or delivery timeline, please let me know. We are looking forward to your confirmation and any additional details you may need from our side.

Best regards,
Jim Schrute

test_cases.name: Polite Verbose Direct Order Request with PO and Delivery Date
test_cases.description: A verbose and polite customer sends a direct order request via email, specifying products, quantities, a purchase order number, and a preferred delivery date, while providing additional business context and explanations.

initial_turn.subject: Direct Order Request – PO #TT-2024-0612, Requested Delivery by July 5th
initial_turn.body:
Dear Sales Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to place a direct order on behalf of Toytopia’s retail division, as we are preparing for our upcoming summer promotional event and need to replenish several of our fast-moving items. Please find the details of our order below:

- MagicToyland Adventure Doll – 25 units
- SmartToys Building Blocks – 15 units
- T-Shirt – 40 units (We have previously ordered different styles from your catalog, so please include a mix of available options. If you need clarification on which T-Shirt variants are currently in stock or most suitable for children ages 6–10, please let me know.)
- WonderWagon Pull-Along Train (Item No: AITEM-0001) – 10 units

For your reference, our internal purchase order number for this transaction is TT-2024-0612. We would greatly appreciate it if you could arrange delivery to our main warehouse by July 5th, as this will allow us sufficient time to prepare for the event launch. If there are any issues with the requested delivery timeline or if you require further details regarding product specifications, please do not hesitate to reach out.

Best regards,
Jessica Stone
